# AI Film Knowledge Base (excerpt)

Source: https://github.com/62656456/ai-film-knowledge-base, commit 7fccce8, by 62656456, under CC BY 4.0 (`LICENSE`).

The notes kept here are unchanged and without their images: `A2-08-camera-language.md`, `A2-02-editing.md`, `A2-01-staging.md` and `C1-04-five-gates.md`. `SHOT_CRAFT` and `REVEAL_ARC` in `src/direction.ts` are adapted from them: condensed, translated into English and fitted to shooting from a finished render. The Director planner and the shot director on the Director page always use it.
